name: icon
title: Icon
description: A Fluent UI System Icon (vendored offline, MIT) as an inline svg: regular or filled artwork, sized by size.icon.*, coloured by currentColor or a token text role.
usage: Use Icon for every pictogram: <Icon icon={ChevronDown} /> with an export of @/lib/icons (ChevronDown, Database, Search, Dismiss). It takes the surrounding text colour (tone="inherit"), or a role through tone (muted, accent, danger, warning, success, info). size follows size.icon.* (xs 12, sm 14, md 16, lg 20, xl 24 px) and picks Fluent's 16, 20 or 24 px drawing. filled is Fluent's solid style, for a selected or active state. An icon beside text is decorative (hidden from screen readers); one that stands alone needs label, or put it in an IconButton with aria-label. Import only the icons you use. To add an icon, vendor it with pnpm --filter @byterygon/ui icons add <name> --from <@fluentui/svg-icons tarball> (offline), never draw one by hand.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon: an export of @/lib/icons (ChevronDown, Database). Without one it renders an empty box of its size.

props.name: size
props.description: Edge from size.icon.* (12, 14, 16, 20, 24 px); xs to md draw Fluent's 16 px artwork, lg the 20 px, xl the 24 px.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour from a text role; inherit keeps the surrounding text colour (currentColor).

props.name: filled
props.description: Fluent's filled (solid) style, for a selected or active state; sets data-filled.

props.name: label
props.description: Names a standalone icon for screen readers (role="img", aria-label); without it the icon is aria-hidden.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render another element with the icon's props.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The icon; data-slot="icon", data-icon (its Fluent name), data-size, data-tone, data-filled.

accessibility: Renders an inline svg with focusable="false"; it is never in the tab order.

Decorative by default (aria-hidden): the text next to it says what it means. A standalone icon takes label (role="img" with aria-label), or sits in an IconButton whose aria-label says what the button does.
Colour is never the only cue: a status icon (Info, Warning, ErrorCircle, CheckmarkCircle) differs in shape too, and status text goes with it. Tones use text roles checked at 4.5:1 on their surfaces.
